verdict.rationale: Superset lets developers add/clone a GitHub repo directly (via GitHub CLI login) and each workspace agent operates in an isolated worktree/branch, with built-in stage/commit/push/Create PR from the diff viewer, giving agents full repo access and PR-opening capability. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the actual GitHub PR creation flow (community evidence covers other features, not PR creation specifically) and no explicit mention of required GitHub auth/permissions scopes.
